{"id":2056371567,"question_id":4346,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 weeks, 4 days","timestamp":1783219745,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/2056371567/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Subsequence After One Replacement","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    bool canMakeSubsequence(string s, string t) {\n        int n = s.size();\n        int m = t.size();\n        \n        vector<int>pref(m+1 , 0);\n        vector<int>suff(m+1 , 0);\n\n        int i = 0;\n        for(int j = 0 ; j<m ; j++){\n            if(i < n and s[i] == t[j]) i++;\n            pref[j+1] = i;\n        }\n\n        i = n-1;\n        for(int j = m-1 ; j >= 0 ; j--){\n            if(i >= 0 and s[i] == t[j]) i--;\n            suff[j] = n-i-1;\n        }\n\n        for(int j = 0 ; j<=m ; j++){\n            int left = pref[j];\n            int right = (j == m ? 0 : suff[j]);\n\n            if(left + right >= n-1) return true;\n        }\n        return false;\n        \n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"subsequence-after-one-replacement","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2298}
